en.t: Philip III, although suffering from dysentery, becomes King of France following the death of his father Louis IX, during the Eighth Crusade. His uncle, Charles I of Naples, is forced to begin peace negotiations with Muhammad I al-Mustansir, Hafsid Sultan of Tunis
en.s: Philip III (1 May 1245 – 5 October 1285), called the Bold (French: le Hardi), was King of France from 1270 until his death in 1285. His father, Louis IX, died in Tunis during the Eighth Crusade. Philip, who was accompanying him, returned to France and was anointed king at Reims in 1271.

zh.t: 第八次十字军东征期间，路易九世去世后患痢疾的腓力三世继任法国国王
zh.s: 腓力三世（1245年5月1日—1285年10月5日），绰号“勇敢者”（法语：le Hardi），于1270年至去世前担任法国国王。他的父亲路易九世在第八次十字军东征期间于突尼斯去世。随父亲出征的腓力返回法国，并于1271年在兰斯加冕为王。

en.s: The naval Battle of Zonchio (Turkish: Sapienza Deniz Muharebesi, also known as the Battle of Sapienza or the First Battle of Lepanto) took place on four separate days: 12, 20, 22 and 25 August 1499. It was a part of the Ottoman–Venetian War of 1499–1503. It was the first naval battle in history where cannons were used on ships. [Citation needed] In January 1499 Kemal Reis set sail from Constantinople with a force of 10 galleys and 4 other types of ships, and in July 1499 met with the huge Ottoman fleet which was sent to him by Davud Pasha and took over its command in order to wage a large scale war against the Republic of Venice.

zh.s: 宗乔海战又称萨皮恩扎海战或第一次勒班陀海战（土耳其语：Sapienza Deniz Muharebesi），分四天进行：1499年8月12日、20日、22日和25日。这是奥斯曼—威尼斯战争（1499—1503年）的一部分。据原文标注，此战是历史上首次在舰船上使用火炮的海战，但该说法需要引文。1499年1月，凯末尔·雷伊斯率领10艘桨帆船和4艘其他类型的船只从君士坦丁堡出发；同年7月，他与达武德帕夏派来的一支庞大奥斯曼舰队会合，并接管指挥，准备与威尼斯共和国展开大规模战争。

en.t: The Honourable Artillery Company, the oldest surviving regiment in the British Army, and the second most senior, is formed
en.s: The Honourable Artillery Company (HAC) is the reserve regiment in the British Army's Land Special Operations Force. Incorporated by royal charter in 1537 by King Henry VIII, it is the oldest regiment in the British Army and is considered the second-oldest military unit in the world. Today, it is also a charity whose purpose is to attend to the "better defence of the realm", primarily through supporting the HAC regiment.

zh.t: 英国陆军荣誉炮兵连成立
zh.s: 荣誉炮兵连（HAC）是英国陆军陆地特种作战部队的预备役团。它于1537年由亨利八世授予皇家特许状正式成立，是英国陆军历史最悠久的团，也被认为是世界第二古老的军事单位。如今，它还是一家慈善机构，主要通过支持该团来履行“更好地保卫王国”的宗旨。

en.s: The siege of Van occurred in 1548 when Suleiman the Magnificent attacked Iran in his second campaign of the Ottoman-Safavid War (1532–1555). The city of Van, which has long been strategically important in Eastern Anatolia, was surrounded, put under siege, and bombarded. On this campaign, Suleiman was accompanied by the French ambassador Gabriel de Luetz, since France wanted to maintain a good relation with the Ottoman Empire.

zh.s: 1548年，苏莱曼大帝在奥斯曼—萨法维战争（1532—1555年）的第二次战役中进攻伊朗，凡城围城战由此发生。凡城长期以来在安纳托利亚东部具有重要战略地位，遭到包围、围困和炮击。这次战役中，法国大使加布里埃尔·德·吕埃茨随苏莱曼同行，因为法国希望维持与奥斯曼帝国的良好关系。

en.t: Battle of the Gulf of Oman
en.s: The Battle of the Gulf of Oman was a naval battle between a large Portuguese armada under Dom Fernando de Meneses and the Ottoman Indian fleet under Seydi Ali Reis. The campaign was a catastrophic failure for the Ottomans who lost all of their ships. Seydi Ali Reis later wrote that the engagement was "worse than any he had lived through under Barbarossa".

en.s: The Battle of Alcântara took place on 25 August 1580, near the brook of Alcântara, in the vicinity of Lisbon, Portugal, and was a decisive victory of the Spanish Habsburg King Philip II over the Portuguese pretender to the Portuguese throne, Dom António, Prior of Crato.

zh.s: 1580年8月25日，阿尔坎塔拉战役在葡萄牙里斯本附近的阿尔坎塔拉溪旁发生。西班牙哈布斯堡王朝国王腓力二世决定性地击败了葡萄牙王位觊觎者、克拉托修道院院长唐·安东尼奥。

en.s: The Battle of Glenmalure (Irish: Cath Ghleann Molúra) took place in Ireland on 25 August 1580 during the Desmond Rebellions. An Irish Catholic force made up of the Gaelic clans from the Wicklow Mountains led by Fiach MacHugh O'Byrne and James Eustace, Viscount Baltinglas of the Pale, defeated an English army under Arthur Grey, 14th Baron Grey de Wilton, at the O'Byrnes' mountain stronghold of Glenmalure.

zh.s: 1580年8月25日，德斯蒙德叛乱期间，格伦马卢尔战役在爱尔兰发生。菲亚赫·麦克休·奥伯恩和帕莱的巴尔廷格拉斯子爵詹姆斯·尤斯塔斯率领一支爱尔兰天主教军队，成员来自威克洛山脉的盖尔氏族，并在奥伯恩家族位于格伦马卢尔的山地据点击败了亚瑟·格雷（第14代威尔顿的格雷男爵）率领的英格兰军队。

en.s: The Battle of Randeniwela was a battle fought on 25 August 1630 in the Sinhalese–Portuguese War. It was fought between Senarat and his sons Prince Mahastana, who would later become Rajasimha II king of Kandy, and his brother Prince Vijayapala against the Portuguese forces commanded by then Governor Constantino de Sá de Noronha. It was fought at Randeniwela near Wellawaya, a place close the town of Badulla. The battle broke off when Constantino de Sá launched the invasion via Badulla. The scene was an important historical event, where the Portuguese army was routed subsequent to the entire Lascarins (local militia) contingent defected.

zh.s: 1630年8月25日，僧伽罗—葡萄牙战争期间，兰德尼韦拉战役在韦拉瓦亚附近发生，战场靠近巴杜勒镇。交战双方分别是塞纳拉特及其儿子、后来成为康提国王拉贾辛哈二世的马哈斯塔纳王子和维贾亚帕拉王子，以及时任总督康斯坦蒂诺·德·萨·德·诺罗尼亚指挥的葡萄牙军队。康斯坦蒂诺·德·萨经由巴杜勒发起入侵后，战斗中断。当地民兵拉斯卡林全员倒戈，导致葡萄牙军队溃败；这是当地一件重要历史事件。

en.s: The siege of Venlo was an important siege in the Eighty Years' War that lasted from 20 to 25 August 1637. The Cardinal-Infante Ferdinand of Austria, Governor of the Spanish Netherlands, retook the city of Venlo from the United Provinces, which had taken control of it in 1632 during the offensive of Frederick Henry, Prince of Orange against Maastricht.

zh.s: 芬洛围城战是八十年战争中的一场重要围城战，持续时间为1637年8月20日至25日。西属尼德兰总督奥地利的费迪南德枢机亲王从联省共和国手中夺回芬洛。联省共和国曾于1632年在奥兰治亲王弗雷德里克·亨德里克进攻马斯特里赫特期间占领该城。

en.s: The Battle of Tarragona of August 1641 was a naval battle that took place between 20 – 25 August 1641, between the Spanish and French fleets during the French stage of the Thirty Years' War. The Spanish fleet, led by the Duke of Fernandina and the Duke of Maqueda broke the French naval blockade of Tarragona and defeated the French fleet under Henri d'Escoubleau de Sourdis, forcing it to retreat.

en.s: The Battle of Wigan Lane was fought on 25 August 1651 during the Third English Civil War, between a Royalist army led by the Earl of Derby and forces loyal to the Commonwealth of England under Colonel Robert Lilburne. The Royalists were defeated, losing nearly half their officers and men.

zh.s: 1651年8月25日，第三次英格兰内战期间，德比伯爵率领的保王军与罗伯特·利尔本上校指挥的英格兰共和国军队在此交战。保王军战败，近半数军官和士兵阵亡。

en.s: The Battle of Vezekény (Hungarian: vezekényi csata) occurred during the 17th century Ottoman Wars in Europe. It was a major Hungarian victory. Tamás Esterházy was killed in the battle along with his younger brother Gáspár and his cousin László.

zh.s: 韦泽肯战役（匈牙利语：vezekényi csata）发生于17世纪奥斯曼帝国在欧洲的战争期间，是匈牙利的一场重大胜利。埃斯泰尔哈齐·塔马斯在战斗中阵亡，其弟加斯帕尔和堂兄拉斯洛也一同战死。

en.s: The Battle of Arras, fought on August 25, 1654, was a victory of a French army under Turenne against a Spanish army commanded by Don Ferdinand de Salis and the Prince de Condé. The place, held by a French garrison, was besieged by the Spaniards under the Great Condé. A relief army under Turenne attacked the Spanish lines and totally routed them with a loss of approximately 3,000 men. Condé succeeded in rallying the remainder of his army and made a masterful retreat to Cambrai.

zh.s: 1654年8月25日，蒂雷纳率领的法军击败了由唐·费尔南多·德·萨利斯和孔代亲王指挥的西班牙军队。西班牙军在大孔代率领下围攻由法军守卫的阿拉斯。蒂雷纳率援军袭击西班牙军阵地，将其彻底击溃，西班牙军损失约3000人。孔代成功收拢残部，巧妙撤退至康布雷。

zh.s: 1656年8月25日，斯特凡·恰尔涅茨基指挥的波兰立陶宛联邦与克里米亚汗国联军，同汉斯·伯德克尔指挥的瑞典军队交战。波兰—鞑靼联军获胜。

en.s: The Battle of Walcourt was fought on 25 August 1689 during the Nine Years' War. The action took place near the ancient walled town of Walcourt near Charleroi in the Spanish Netherlands, and brought to a close a summer of uneventful marching, manoeuvring, and foraging. The battle was a success for the Grand Alliance – the only significant engagement in the theatre during the campaign of 1689. The Allied army was commanded by the Prince of Waldeck; the French army by the duc de Humières. The battle incurred some 2,000 French casualties against the Allied losses of less than 300.

zh.s: 1689年8月25日，九年战争期间，瓦尔库尔战役在西属尼德兰、沙勒罗瓦附近的古城墙镇瓦尔库尔一带打响，结束了一个夏季平淡无事的行军、机动和觅食活动。这是大同盟的胜利，也是1689年战役中该地区唯一一场重要交战。联军由瓦尔德克亲王指挥，法军由于米耶尔公爵指挥。法军伤亡约2000人，联军损失不到300人。

en.s: The action of August 1702 was an inconclusive naval battle of the War of the Spanish Succession fought between 19 and 25 August 1702 O.S.. An English squadron under Vice-admiral John Benbow engaged in a running battle with a smaller French squadron under Admiral Jean-Baptiste du Casse off Santa Marta, but insubordination from Benbow's captains prevented him from inflicting significant damage on du Casse's squadron, which escaped almost fully intact.

zh.s: 西班牙王位继承战争期间，1702年8月19日至25日（旧历）在圣玛尔塔附近发生了一场未分胜负的海战。约翰·本博海军中将率领的英国分舰队与让-巴蒂斯特·迪卡斯上将指挥的一支规模较小的法国分舰队交战，但本博的舰长们不服从命令，使他无法重创法军。迪卡斯的舰队几乎完整地脱身。

en.s: The Battle of Zorndorf was a battle fought on August 25, 1758 during the Seven Years' War, fought between the forces of the Russians troops under the command of Count William Fermor and a Prussian army under King Frederick the Great. The battle was tactically inconclusive, with both armies holding the ground and claiming victory. The site of the battle was the Prussian village Zorndorf (now Sarbinowo, Poland).

zh.s: 七年战争期间，1758年8月25日，威廉·费莫尔伯爵指挥的俄军与腓特烈大帝率领的普鲁士军队在佐恩多夫交战。这场战役在战术上没有明确胜负，双方都守住了阵地并宣称获胜。战场位于普鲁士的佐恩多夫村（今波兰萨尔比诺沃）。

en.s: The Battle of Piteå occurred on 25 August 1809, near Piteå, Sweden. A Swedish naval force under the command of Major C.F. von Hauswolff was ordered to cut off the northward retreat of a Russian force under General Nikolay Kamensky which had been defeated by the Swedes five days earlier at Ratan.

zh.s: 皮特奥战役于1809年8月25日在瑞典皮特奥附近发生。瑞典海军部队由C. F. 冯·豪斯沃尔夫少校指挥，奉命截断俄军向北撤退的路线。俄军由尼古拉·卡缅斯基将军指挥，五天前刚在拉坦被瑞典军队击败。

en.s: The Battle of Zepita, also known as the Battle of Chua Chua, was fought between the forces of future Peruvian president Santa Cruz and the Viceroyalty of Peru. Santa Cruz's army captured 240 rifles, 52 saddles, 240 lances and 63 sabers from the Royalist army.

zh.s: 泽皮塔战役也称丘亚丘亚战役，交战双方是未来的秘鲁总统圣克鲁斯率领的部队和秘鲁总督辖区军队。圣克鲁斯的军队从保王党军队缴获了240支步枪、52副马鞍、240支长矛和63把军刀。

en.s: Uruguay, officially the Oriental Republic of Uruguay, is a country in southeastern South America. It shares borders with Argentina to its west and southwest and Brazil to its north and northeast, while bordering the Río de la Plata to the south and the Atlantic Ocean to the southeast. It is part of the Southern Cone region of South America.

zh.s: 乌拉圭，正式名称为乌拉圭东岸共和国，是南美洲东南部的国家。西面和西南面与阿根廷接壤，北面和东北面与巴西接壤；南临拉普拉塔河，东南濒临大西洋。乌拉圭属于南美洲南锥体地区。

en.t: The first Great Moon Hoax article is published in The New York Sun, announcing the discovery of life and civilization on the Moon
en.s: The "Great Moon Hoax", also known as the "Great Moon Hoax of 1835", was a series of six articles published in New York newspaper The Sun, beginning on August 25, 1835, about the supposed discovery of life and civilization on the Moon. The discoveries were falsely attributed to Sir John Herschel and his fictitious companion Andrew Grant.

zh.t: 《纽约太阳报》刊出第一篇“月球大骗局”文章，宣称发现月球上的生命和文明
zh.s: “月球大骗局”也称“1835年月球大骗局”，是纽约报纸《太阳报》于1835年8月25日开始刊出的一组六篇文章，声称在月球上发现了生命和文明。文章虚假地把这些发现归功于约翰·赫歇尔爵士及其虚构的同伴安德鲁·格兰特。

en.s: The Passaleão incident (Chinese: 關閘事件), also known as the Battle of Passaleão (or Pak Shan Lan) or Baishaling incident, was a conflict between Portugal and China over Macau in August 1849. The Chinese were defeated in the only military confrontation, but the Portuguese called off further punitive measures after a naval explosion killed about 200 sailors.

zh.s: 帕萨良事件（中文：關閘事件）又称帕萨良之战（或Pak Shan Lan）或白石岭事件，是1849年8月葡萄牙与中国围绕澳门发生的冲突。中国方面在唯一一次军事交锋中战败，但一次海上爆炸造成约200名水手死亡后，葡萄牙停止了进一步惩罚行动。

en.s: The Battle of Najafgarh was a subsidiary engagement of the Siege of Delhi during the Indian Rebellion of 1857. A large Indian force sortied from Delhi, intending to attack the rear of the British force besieging the city. A detachment from the besiegers marched to intercept them, and defeated them while they were disordered by difficult terrain and by quarrels among their commanders.

zh.s: 纳贾夫加尔战役是1857年印度起义期间德里围城战的附属战斗。一支规模庞大的印度部队从德里出击，计划袭击围攻该城的英军后方。围城英军派出一支分队拦截，印度部队因地形艰险和指挥官之间发生争执而阵形混乱，最终被英军击败。

en.s: The Siege and Storming of Ghunib was a decisive encounter at the mountain stronghold of Ghunib, conducted by Russian forces in August 1859. After 25 years of leading fierce resistance against Russian expansion, Imam Shamil, the leader of the Caucasian Imamate, was captured and forced to surrender, marking the effective end of the Murid War.

en.s: The Second Battle of Ream's Station (also Reams or Reams's) was fought during the Siege of Petersburg in the American Civil War on August 25, 1864, in Dinwiddie County, Virginia. A Union force under Maj. Gen. Winfield S. Hancock began destroying part of the Weldon Railroad, which was a vital supply line for Gen. Robert E. Lee's Confederate army in Petersburg, Virginia. Lee sent a force under Lt. Gen. A. P. Hill to challenge Hancock and the Confederates were able to rout the Union troops from their fortifications at Reams Station.

en.s: Toma de Mercedes was the takeover of the city of Mercedes, Uruguay by the Ejército Blanco under the command of Timoteo Aparicio on August 25, 1870, during the Revolution of the Lances in the Banda Oriental. Prominent Blancos officers including Anacleto Medina and Gerónimo Amilivia served in the revolutionary army. Among the leaders of the Colorado party who took part in the defense of the city was Juan Idiarte Borda, future Uruguayan president.

zh.s: 1870年8月25日，蒂莫特奥·阿帕里西奥指挥的白党军队在东岸省的长矛革命期间攻占了乌拉圭梅赛德斯城。安纳克莱托·梅迪纳和赫罗尼莫·阿米利维亚等白党重要军官参加了革命军。参与守城的红党领导人中包括后来成为乌拉圭总统的胡安·伊迪亚特·博尔达。

en.s: The Battle of Kizil-tepe (Turkish: Kızıltepe Muharebesi) was fought on August 25, 1877, between the Russian Empire and the Ottoman Empire. The Russian were attempting to besiege Kars. The Ottomans, vastly superior in numbers, successfully lifted the siege. The Ottoman forces were supported by the Polish legion in Turkey.

zh.s: 克孜尔泰佩战役（土耳其语：Kızıltepe Muharebesi）于1877年8月25日发生在俄罗斯帝国与奥斯曼帝国之间。俄军试图围攻卡尔斯，但人数占优的奥斯曼军队成功解围。奥斯曼军队还得到土耳其境内波兰军团的支援。

en.s: The Treaty of Huế, (Vietnamese: Hòa ước Harmand, Hòa ước Quý Mùi) concluded on 25 August 1883 between Vietnam (Nguyễn dynasty) and France, recognising a French protectorate over Vietnam being divided into Annam and Tonkin. Dictated to the Vietnamese by the French administrator François-Jules Harmand in the wake of the French military seizure of the Thuận An forts, the treaty is often known as the 'Harmand Treaty'.

zh.s: 顺化条约（越南语：Hòa ước Harmand，Hòa ước Quý Mùi）于1883年8月25日由越南（阮朝）与法国签订，承认法国对越南的保护国地位，并将越南划分为安南和东京两部分。法国军队夺取顺安堡垒后，法国官员弗朗索瓦-朱尔·阿尔芒将条约强加给越南，因此该条约也常称为“阿尔芒条约”。

en.s: The 1901 Tie Cup final was the final match to decide the winner of the Tie Cup, the 2nd edition of the international competition organised by the Argentine and Uruguayan Associations together. The final was contested by two Argentine sides, Alumni and Rosario A.C., from Buenos Aires and Rosario respectively. Alumni played its first final while Rosario contested its second consecutive final. The match was held in the Lomas Athletic field in the suburb of Lomas de Zamora, on 25 August 1901.

zh.s: 1901年平局杯决赛决定了第二届平局杯的冠军。这项国际赛事由阿根廷和乌拉圭足协共同组织。决赛由两支阿根廷球队交锋：来自布宜诺斯艾利斯的阿尔米尼队和来自罗萨里奥的罗萨里奥竞技俱乐部。阿尔米尼队首次闯入决赛，罗萨里奥竞技俱乐部则连续第二年进入决赛。比赛于1901年8月25日在洛马斯-德萨莫拉郊区的洛马斯竞技场举行。

zh.t: 淡水线正式开通，共设五个车站
zh.s: 淡水线也称淡水支线，是一条铁路支线，位于台北和新北，由台湾铁路管理局运营。该线路连接台北市与淡水镇，于1901年8月25日正式开通，当时设有五个车站。如今，这条线路由台北捷运淡水信义线接替服务。

en.s: The Battle of Liaoyang (遼陽会戦, Ryōyō-kaisen; 25 August – 3 September 1904) (Russian: Сражение при Ляояне) was a major land battle of the Russo-Japanese War, on the outskirts of the city of Liaoyang in present-day Liaoning Province, China. The city was of great strategic importance as the major Russian military center for southern Manchuria, and a major population center on the main line on the Russian South Manchurian Railway connecting Port Arthur with Mukden.

en.t: The Kuomintang is founded for the first time in Peking
en.s: The Kuomintang (KMT) is a major political party in the Republic of China (Taiwan). It was the sole ruling party of mainland China from 1928 to 1949 until its relocation to Taiwan, and in Taiwan ruled under martial law until 1987. The KMT is a centre-right to right-wing party and the largest in the Pan-Blue Coalition, one of Taiwan's two main political groups.

zh.t: 国民党首次在北京成立
zh.s: 中国国民党（KMT）是中华民国（台湾）的主要政党。1928年至1949年间，它是中国大陆的唯一执政党，直至迁往台湾；在台湾则实行戒严统治，直至1987年。国民党属于中间偏右至右翼政党，是泛蓝联盟中规模最大的政党；泛蓝联盟是台湾两大政治阵营之一。

en.t: Creation of the National Park Service
en.s: The National Park Service (NPS) is an agency of the United States Department of the Interior. The service manages all national parks; most national monuments; and other natural, historical, and recreational properties, with various title designations. The United States Congress created the agency on August 25, 1916, through the National Park Service Organic Act. Its headquarters is in Washington, D.C., within the main headquarters of the Department of the Interior.

zh.s: 美国国家公园管理局（NPS）是内政部下属机构，负责管理所有国家公园、大多数国家纪念地，以及其他自然、历史和休闲类土地。1916年8月25日，美国国会通过《国家公园管理局组织法》，设立了该机构。管理局总部位于华盛顿特区内政部总部大楼。

en.s: The Battle of Hill 70 was a battle of World War I between the Canadian Corps and five divisions of the German 6th Army. The battle took place along the Western Front on the outskirts of Lens in the Nord-Pas-de-Calais region of France between 15 and 25 August 1917. The objectives of the assault were to inflict casualties and to draw German troops away from the 3rd Battle of Ypres, rather than to capture territory.

zh.s: 第一次世界大战期间，加拿大军团与德军第6集团军的5个师在70高地交战。战斗于1917年8月15日至25日在法国北部-加来海峡大区朗斯郊外的西线展开。进攻目标是杀伤德军兵力，并将德军从第三次伊普尔战役调开，而不是夺取领土。

en.s: The Battle of Warsaw (Polish: Bitwa Warszawska; Russian: Варшавская битва, Varshavskaya bitva), also known as the Miracle on the Vistula (Polish: Cud nad Wisłą), was a series of battles that resulted in a decisive Polish victory and complete disintegration of the Red Army in August 1920 during the Polish–Soviet War. After the Polish Kiev offensive, Soviet forces launched a successful counterattack in summer 1920, forcing the Polish army to retreat westward.

en.s: The Westminster Abbey by-election, 1921 was a parliamentary by-election held on 25 August 1921 for the British House of Commons constituency of Westminster Abbey in London. Burdett-Coutts had held the seat since it had been created for the 1918 general election, when he had been returned unopposed.

en.s: The 1933 Diexi earthquake occurred in Diexi, Mao County, Sichuan, Republic of China on August 25 with a moment magnitude of 7.3 and a maximum Mercalli intensity of X (Extreme). With up to 9,300 killed, this was the deadliest earthquake in 1933. This earthquake destroyed the town of Diexi and surrounding villages, and caused many landslides. The old town of Diexi was submerged in the landslide dam-created Diexi Lake.

en.t: World War II: The first Bombing of Berlin by the British Royal Air Force
en.s: Berlin, the capital of Germany, was subject to 363 air raids during the Second World War. zh.t: 第二次世界大战：英国皇家空军首次轰炸柏林

en.s: Convoy ON 122 was a trade convoy of merchant ships during the Second World War. It was the 122nd of the numbered series of ON convoys Outbound from the British Isles to North America. en.t: World War II: Japanese forces attacked the Australian base at Milne Bay during the New Guinea campaign
en.s: The Battle of Milne Bay (25 August – 7 September 1942), also known as Operation RE or the Battle of Rabi (ラビの戦い) by the Japanese, was a battle of the Pacific campaign of World War II. Japanese naval infantry, known as Kaigun Tokubetsu Rikusentai (Special Naval Landing Forces), with two small tanks attacked the Allied airfields at Milne Bay that had been established on the eastern tip of New Guinea.

zh.s: 米尔恩湾战役（1942年8月25日至9月7日）也称“RE行动”或日方所称的“拉比战役”（ラビの戦い），是第二次世界大战太平洋战场的一场战役。日军海军特别陆战队派出两辆轻型坦克，进攻设在新几内亚东端米尔恩湾的盟军机场。

en.s: The Liberation of Paris (French: Libération de Paris) was a battle that took place during World War II from 19 August 1944 until the German garrison surrendered the French capital on 25 August 1944. Paris had been occupied by Nazi Germany since the signing of the Armistice of 22 June 1940, after which the Wehrmacht occupied northern and western France.

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held for the first Supreme People's Assembly in North Korea on 25 August 1948. A total of 572 deputies were elected, of which 360 were reserved for representatives of South Korea. The North Korean government claimed that 77.8% of South Korean voters had taken part in underground elections to elect 1,000 delegates who would elect the 360 South Korean members of the SPA. Only one candidate was presented in each constituency, all of which were selected by the Workers' Party of Korea, although some ran under the banner of other parties or state organisations to give an appearance of democracy.

zh.s: 1948年8月25日，朝鲜举行首届最高人民会议选举，共选出572名议员，其中360席留给南朝鲜代表。朝鲜政府声称，77.8%的南朝鲜选民参加了秘密选举，选出1000名代表，再由他们选出最高人民会议的360名南朝鲜议员。每个选区只推出一名候选人，候选人均由朝鲜劳动党选定；不过，有些人以其他政党或国家组织的名义参选，以营造民主的表象。

en.t: President Jânio Quadros of Brazil resigns after just seven months in power, initiating a political crisis that culminates in a military coup in 1964
en.s: Jânio da Silva Quadros (Portuguese: [ˈʒɐ̃niu dɐ ˈsiwvɐ ˈkwadɾus] ; 25 January 1917 – 16 February 1992) was a Brazilian lawyer and politician who served as the 22nd president of Brazil from 31 January to 25 August 1961, when he resigned from office. He also served as the 24th and 36th mayor of São Paulo, and the 18th governor of the state of São Paulo.

zh.t: 巴西总统雅尼奥·夸德罗斯执政近七个月后辞职，引发最终导致1964年军事政变的政治危机
zh.s: 雅尼奥·达席尔瓦·夸德罗斯（葡萄牙语：[ˈʒɐ̃niu dɐ ˈsiwvɐ ˈkwadɾus]；1917年1月25日—1992年2月16日）是巴西律师和政治人物，曾任巴西第22任总统。他于1961年1月31日至8月25日在任，并于8月25日辞职。他还曾两度担任圣保罗市长，并任圣保罗州第18任州长。

en.s: Operation Sadar (lit. 'Conscious'; Indonesian: Operasi Sadar) was a military campaign conducted by the Indonesian National Armed Forces (TNI) in Papua, targeting villages suspected of supporting the Free Papua Movement. The operation was also a direct response to the 1965 Arfai incident, which had heightened tensions in the region. During the campaign, TNI forces attacked these villages, destroying several communities and displacing much of the local population.

zh.s: Sadar行动（字面意思为“觉醒”；印度尼西亚语：Operasi Sadar）是印度尼西亚国民军（TNI）在巴布亚开展的一场军事行动，目标是袭击被怀疑支持自由巴布亚运动的村庄。该行动也是对1965年阿尔法伊事件的直接回应；该事件曾加剧当地紧张局势。行动期间，印尼军队袭击了这些村庄，摧毁多个社区，并迫使当地大量居民流离失所。

en.s: On August 25, 1967, George Lincoln Rockwell, an American neo-Nazi political activist and the leader of the National Socialist White People's Party (NSWPP), formerly the American Nazi Party (ANP), was assassinated by John Patler, an expelled member of the NSWPP. Patler fired two shots at Rockwell from the roof of a nearby building, while Rockwell was visiting a local laundromat close to the party's headquarters in Arlington, Virginia.

zh.s: 1967年8月25日，美国新纳粹政治活动人士、国家社会主义白人党（NSWPP，前身为美国纳粹党）领导人乔治·林肯·洛克威尔遭到暗杀。开除出党籍的NSWPP成员约翰·帕特勒在附近一栋建筑的屋顶向洛克威尔开了两枪。当时洛克威尔正在弗吉尼亚州阿灵顿、靠近该党总部的一家洗衣店。

zh.s: 1973年北美足球联赛决赛是该赛季的冠军赛，由新加入联赛的费城原子队对阵达拉斯龙卷风队。比赛于1973年8月25日在德克萨斯州欧文的德州体育场举行。费城原子队以2比0获胜，成为1973年北美足球联赛冠军。

en.s: NASL Final 1974 was the championship match of the 1974 season, between the expansion Los Angeles Aztecs and the Miami Toros. The match was played on August 25, 1974 at the Orange Bowl, in Miami, Florida. The teams played to a, 3–3, draw, and after a short break the game moved directly to a penalty shoot-out. Los Angeles won the shoot-out, 5–3, and were crowned the 1974 champions.

zh.s: 1974年8月25日，扩军球队洛杉矶阿兹特克队与迈阿密托罗斯队在佛罗里达州迈阿密的橙碗球场争夺当季冠军。双方常规比赛战成3比3，短暂休息后直接进行点球大战。洛杉矶队以5比3获胜，成为1974年冠军。

en.s: The Bayreuth Festival (German: Bayreuther Festspiele) is a music festival held annually in Bayreuth, Germany, at which performances of stage works by the 19th-century German composer Richard Wagner are presented. Wagner himself conceived and promoted the idea of a special festival to showcase his own works, in particular his monumental cycle Der Ring des Nibelungen and Parsifal. Performances take place in a specially designed theatre, the Bayreuth Festspielhaus.
en.n: The last performance of the Jahrhundertring at the Bayreuth Festival receives ovations of 45 minutes.

zh.s: 拜罗伊特音乐节（德语：Bayreuther Festspiele）是德国拜罗伊特每年举办的音乐节，演出19世纪德国作曲家理查德·瓦格纳的舞台作品。瓦格纳本人构思并推动创办这一专门演出其作品的音乐节，重点包括大型歌剧系列《尼伯龙根的指环》和《帕西法尔》。演出在专门设计的拜罗伊特节日剧院举行。
zh.n: 拜罗伊特音乐节《世纪指环》系列的最后一场演出获得了45分钟的掌声。

en.t: Voyager 2 spacecraft makes its closest approach to Neptune, the last planet in the Solar System at the time, due to Pluto being within Neptune's orbit from 1979 to 1999
en.s: Voyager 2 is a space probe launched by NASA on August 20, 1977, as a part of the Voyager program. It was launched on a trajectory towards the gas giants (Jupiter and Saturn) and enabled further encounters with the ice giants (Uranus and Neptune). The only spacecraft to have visited either of the ice giant planets, it was the third of five spacecraft to achieve Solar escape velocity, which allowed it to leave the Solar System.

zh.t: 旅行者2号飞船最接近海王星；当时因冥王星在1979年至1999年间位于海王星轨道内，海王星是太阳系最外侧的行星
zh.s: 旅行者2号是NASA于1977年8月20日发射的太空探测器，属于旅行者计划。它最初飞向气态巨行星木星和土星，随后继续探访冰巨星天王星和海王星。它是迄今唯一访问过天王星或海王星的航天器，也是达到太阳逃逸速度的五艘航天器中的第三艘，因此能够飞出太阳系。

en.s: The Battle of Vukovar was an 87-day siege of Vukovar in eastern Croatia by the Yugoslav People's Army (JNA), supported by various paramilitary forces from Serbia, between August and November 1991. Before the Croatian War of Independence the Baroque town was a prosperous, mixed community of Croats, Serbs and other ethnic groups. As Yugoslavia began to break up, Serbia's President Slobodan Milošević and Croatia's President Franjo Tuđman began pursuing nationalist politics.
en.n: The Battle of Vukovar begins. An 87-day siege of Vukovar by the Yugoslav People's Army (JNA), supported by various Serb paramilitary forces, between August and November 1991 (during the Croatian War of Independence).

zh.s: 1991年8月至11月，南斯拉夫人民军（JNA）在塞尔维亚多支准军事部队支持下，对克罗地亚东部的武科瓦尔围城达87天。克罗地亚独立战争前，这座巴洛克风格的城镇繁荣发展，居民包括克罗地亚人、塞尔维亚人和其他族群。南斯拉夫开始解体后，塞尔维亚总统斯洛博丹·米洛舍维奇和克罗地亚总统弗拉尼奥·图季曼开始推行民族主义政治。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Togo on 25 August 1993. They were the first presidential elections in the country to feature more than one candidate. However, the major opposition parties boycotted the election, and only two minor candidates ran against incumbent President Gnassingbé Eyadéma, who ultimately won over 95% of the vote. en.s: The 2000 UEFA Super Cup was a football match played on 25 August 2000 between Real Madrid of Spain and Galatasaray of Turkey. Real Madrid qualified by beating Valencia in the 2000 UEFA Champions League Final, while Galatasaray had made it to the Super Cup after beating Arsenal in the 2000 UEFA Cup Final. Galatasaray won the match 2–1, both goals scored by Mário Jardel, the latter a golden goal.

Among the victims were American singer and actress Aaliyah and members of her entourage, including a hairdresser, her bodyguard and a record executive.

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Rwanda on 25 August 2003. They were the first presidential elections since the Rwandan Civil War and the first multi-party presidential elections in the country's history. Paul Kagame of the Rwandan Patriotic Front was elected with 95% of the vote.

en.s: Hurricane Katrina was an extremely powerful and catastrophic tropical cyclone that affected the Southeastern United States in late August 2005, particularly in and around the city of New Orleans. Katrina became the United States' costliest tropical cyclone, with an estimated $125 billion ($206 billion when adjusted for inflation) in damages. The hurricane killed 1,392 people, making it the deadliest American hurricane since the 1928 Okeechobee hurricane.
en.n: Hurricane Katrina makes landfall in Florida.

zh.n: 卡特里娜飓风在佛罗里达州登陆。

en.s: On 25 August 2010, a Let L-410 Turbolet passenger aircraft of Filair crashed on approach to Bandundu Airport in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, killing all but one of the 21 people on board. From a statement by the sole survivor, the accident was possibly the result of the occupants rushing to the front of the aircraft to escape from a crocodile smuggled on board by one of the passengers. The move compromised the aircraft's balance to the point that control of the aircraft was lost. However, some sources doubt this claim.

zh.s: 2010年8月25日，菲莱尔航空一架Let L-410 Turbolet客机在刚果民主共和国班顿杜机场进近时坠毁，机上21人中只有1人幸存。唯一幸存者称，可能是因为乘客为了躲避一名乘客偷带上机的鳄鱼而挤向机头，导致飞机失去平衡和控制。不过，部分来源对这一说法存疑。

en.s: On August 25, 2011, members of the drug cartel Los Zetas set a casino on fire in Monterrey, Nuevo León, Mexico, killing 52 people. The arson attack left over a dozen injured, and over 35 trapped for several hours. Mexican forces, which arrived minutes after the incident, eventually used backhoes to break down the walls and free the trapped victims. Media reports state the majority of those killed were women, including one who was pregnant. Although the government crackdown on the drug cartels dates back to 2006, Monterrey became an increasingly violent city in 2010, due to the rupture between the Gulf Cartel and Los Zetas.

zh.s: 2011年8月25日，泽塔斯贩毒集团成员在墨西哥新莱昂州蒙特雷纵火焚烧一家赌场，造成52人死亡。纵火还导致十多人受伤，另有35人以上被困数小时。墨西哥军警在事发数分钟后赶到，最终用挖掘机拆墙救出被困者。媒体报道称，死者多数为女性，其中包括一名孕妇。墨西哥政府自2006年起打击贩毒集团；由于海湾贩毒集团与泽塔斯集团决裂，蒙特雷在2010年暴力事件日益增多。

en.s: A general election was held in the Northern Territory on Saturday 25 August 2012, which elected all 25 members of the Legislative Assembly in the unicameral Northern Territory Parliament. The 11-year Labor Party government led by Chief Minister Paul Henderson was decisively defeated in their attempt to win a fourth term against the opposition Country Liberal Party led by opposition leader Terry Mills with a swing of five seats, losing the normally safe Labor remote seats of Arafura, Arnhem, Daly, Namatjira and Stuart, whilst retaining their urban seats picked up at the 2001 election.

zh.s: 2012年8月25日星期六，北领地举行大选，选出北领地一院制议会全部25名议员。首席部长保罗·亨德森领导的工党政府执政11年，试图赢得第四个任期，但被特里·米尔斯领导的反对党乡村自由党大幅击败，席位净转移5席。工党失去了通常稳固的偏远选区阿拉富拉、阿纳姆、戴利、纳马吉拉和斯图尔特，但保住了2001年赢得的城市选区。

en.t: Voyager 1 spacecraft enters interstellar space, becoming the first man-made object to do so
en.s: Voyager 1 is a space probe launched by NASA on September 5, 1977, as part of the Voyager program, to study the outer Solar System and the interstellar space beyond the Sun's heliosphere. It was launched 16 days after its twin, Voyager 2. It communicates through the NASA Deep Space Network (DSN) to receive routine commands and to transmit data to Earth.

zh.t: 旅行者1号进入星际空间，成为首个人造星际物体
zh.s: 旅行者1号是美国国家航空航天局“旅行者计划”中的一艘空间探测器，于1977年9月5日发射，任务是研究太阳系外部以及太阳日球层之外的星际空间。它比姊妹探测器旅行者2号晚16天发射。探测器通过美国国家航空航天局深空网接收常规指令并向地球传回数据。

The election is officially nonpartisan. Had no candidate wins a majority of the vote, a runoff would have been held on November 3 between the top two finishers.

en.s: The 2015 Montgomery mayoral election took place on August 25, 2015, to elect the Mayor of Montgomery, Alabama. Had no candidate received a majority of the vote, a runoff election would have been held between the top two candidates. zh.s: 2016年阿尔巴尼亚超级杯是该项年度足球赛事的第23届比赛。参赛队伍由上赛季阿尔巴尼亚超级联赛冠军和阿尔巴尼亚杯冠军组成。本届由2015—16赛季超级联赛冠军科尔察斯坎德培队对阵阿尔巴尼亚杯冠军库克斯队。

en.s: Hurricane Harvey was a powerful and catastrophic tropical cyclone that made landfall in Texas and Louisiana in August 2017, causing widespread flooding and more than 100 deaths. It is tied with 2005's Hurricane Katrina as the costliest tropical cyclone on record, inflicting $125 billion (2017 USD) in damage, primarily from catastrophic rainfall-triggered flooding in Greater Houston and Southeast Texas; this made the storm the costliest natural disaster recorded in Texas at the time.
en.n: Hurricane Harvey makes landfall in Texas as a powerful Category 4 hurricane, the strongest hurricane to make landfall in the United States since 2004.

zh.s: 哈维飓风是一次强烈且破坏严重的热带气旋，于2017年8月在得克萨斯州和路易斯安那州登陆，引发大范围洪灾，造成100多人死亡。它造成1250亿美元（2017年美元）的损失，与2005年的卡特里娜飓风并列为有记录以来造成损失最高的热带气旋。损失主要来自休斯敦大都会区和得克萨斯州东南部的强降雨洪灾；当时它也是得州有记录以来损失最大的自然灾害。
zh.n: 哈维飓风以强劲的四级飓风强度在得克萨斯州登陆，是自2004年以来在美国登陆的最强飓风。

en.t: Conflict in Rakhine State (2016–present): One hundred seventy people are killed in at least 26 separate attacks carried out by the Arakan Rohingya Salvation Army, leading to the governments of Myanmar and Malaysia designating the group as a terrorist organisation
en.s: Violent clashes have been ongoing in the northern part of Myanmar's Rakhine State since October 2016. Insurgent attacks by the Arakan Rohingya Salvation Army (ARSA) have led to sectarian violence perpetrated by Myanmar's military and the local Buddhist population against predominantly Muslim Rohingya civilians. The conflict has sparked international outcry and was described as an ethnic cleansing by the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights.

zh.s: 自2016年10月以来，缅甸若开邦北部持续发生暴力冲突。若开罗兴亚救世军（ARSA）发动叛乱袭击后，缅甸军方和当地佛教徒对以穆斯林为主的罗兴亚平民实施教派暴力。冲突引发国际社会强烈谴责，联合国人权事务高级专员将其描述为种族清洗。

en.s: UFC Fight Night: Gaethje vs. Vick (also known as UFC Fight Night 135) was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that was held on August 25, 2018 at Pinnacle Bank Arena in Lincoln, Nebraska, United States.

zh.s: UFC格斗之夜：盖奇对阵维克也称UFC格斗之夜135，是终极格斗冠军赛（UFC）举办的一场综合格斗赛事，于2018年8月25日在美国内布拉斯加州林肯市的顶峰银行体育馆举行。

en.s: The 2018 UAE Super Cup was the 11th professional and 18th overall edition of the UAE Super Cup, held at the 30 June Stadium, Cairo on 25 August 2018, between Al Ain, winners of both the 2017–18 UAE Pro-League and 2017–18 UAE President's Cup, and Al Wahda, winners of the 2017–18 UAE League Cup. Al Wahda won the game 4–3 on penalties.

zh.s: 2018年阿联酋超级杯是该赛事第11届职业比赛，也是总计第18届赛事，于2018年8月25日在开罗的六月三十日体育场举行。参赛队伍为2017—18赛季阿联酋职业联赛和总统杯双料冠军艾因队，以及联赛杯冠军阿尔瓦赫达队。阿尔瓦赫达队在点球大战中以4比3获胜。

en.s: The 2019 Macanese Chief Executive election was held on 25 August 2019 for the 5th term of the Chief Executive of Macau (CE), the highest office of the Macau Special Administrative Region. Incumbent Chief Executive Fernando Chui, who was re-elected once already, was not eligible to run for the office under Macao Basic Law, the mini-constitution of the territory.

zh.s: 2019年8月25日，澳门举行选举，选出第五届行政长官。时任行政长官崔世安已连任一次，根据澳门基本法（澳门特别行政区的宪制性文件），不得再竞选这一职位。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in the partially recognized Republic of Abkhazia in 2019. As no candidate gathered more than 50% of the votes in the first round 25 August, a second was held on 8 September between the top two candidates, incumbent President Raul Khajimba of the Forum for the National Unity of Abkhazia and Alkhas Kvitsinia of Amtsakhara.

en.s: The 2020 Tulsa mayoral election was held on August 25, 2020, to elect the mayor of Tulsa, Oklahoma. One-term incumbent Republican mayor G. T. Bynum ran for re-election against a number of candidates. Bynum won re-election outright, negating the need for a runoff.

zh.s: 2020年8月25日，俄克拉何马州塔尔萨举行市长选举。共和党籍现任市长G·T·拜纳姆竞选连任，面对多名候选人。拜纳姆直接胜选，无需举行决选。

en.s: The 2020 Ukrainian Super Cup was the 17th edition of Ukrainian Super Cup, an annual season opener football match contested by the previous season's Ukrainian Premier League champions Shakhtar Donetsk and Ukrainian Cup winners Dynamo Kyiv.

en.s: The 2021 Major League Soccer All-Star Game was the 25th edition of the annual Major League Soccer All-Star Game, an exhibition soccer match in the United States. The game, featuring the MLS All-Stars taking on the Liga MX All-Stars, was played at Banc of California Stadium in Los Angeles, California. The game was originally scheduled to take place on July 29, 2020, during the 2020 season, but was postponed on May 19, 2021, due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

zh.t: 2021年美国职业足球大联盟全明星赛
zh.s: 2021年美国职业足球大联盟全明星赛是这项年度表演赛的第25届，由美职联全明星队对阵墨西哥足球甲级联赛全明星队。比赛在加利福尼亚州洛杉矶的加州银行体育场举行。比赛原定于2020赛季的7月29日进行，后因新冠疫情于2021年5月19日延期。

en.s: The liberation of Gooja'ade (also written Goojacade, Gooja'adde or Goojaadde) was a major military engagement on 25 August 2023 during the 2023 Las Anod conflict. It involved forces of the self-declared Somaliland and the pro-unity SSC-Khatumo movement, fighting for control of the Gooja'ade (Gooja’adde) military base near Las Anod in the Sool region. SSC forces claimed to have overrun the base and seized equipment, a development widely reported as a significant setback for Somaliland.

zh.s: 2023年8月25日，2023年拉斯阿诺德冲突期间，索马里兰（自称独立）部队与支持统一的SSC-卡图莫运动为争夺索勒地区拉斯阿诺德附近的古贾阿德军事基地而交战。SSC方面称其部队已攻占基地并缴获装备；这一进展被广泛报道为索马里兰遭遇的重大挫折。

en.s: The 2023 Malaysia Super League match between Kelantan and Selangor at Sultan Muhammad IV Stadium, Kota Bharu, took place on Friday 25 August 2023. Selangor won the match 11–2, for the largest win in the history of the competition. The result also set the new record for the biggest away win in the history of Malaysian top-flight football.

zh.s: 2023年8月25日星期五，吉兰丹队与雪兰莪队在哥打巴鲁的苏丹穆罕默德四世体育场进行马来西亚超级联赛比赛。雪兰莪以11比2获胜，创下该项赛事最大比分胜利纪录，也刷新马来西亚顶级联赛客队最大比分获胜纪录。

en.s: A by-election was held in Vaduz on 25 August 2024 to elect the mayor of Vaduz following the resignation of incumbent mayor Petra Miescher. The result was a win for Florian Meier of the Progressive Citizens' Party (FBP), who was elected to the position unopposed.

zh.s: 2024年8月25日，瓦杜兹举行补选，选出市长，起因是时任市长佩特拉·米舍尔辞职。进步公民党（FBP）的弗洛里安·迈尔获胜，并在没有对手的情况下当选。

en.s: The 2024 Leagues Cup final was the final match of the fourth edition of the Leagues Cup, a soccer tournament played between clubs from Major League Soccer (MLS) and Liga MX. The match was played on August 25, 2024 at Lower.com Field in Columbus, Ohio, United States, by host Columbus Crew and Los Angeles FC. Columbus won 3–1 with two goals from Cucho Hernández; the match was attended by 20,190 spectators.

zh.s: 2024年联盟杯决赛是第四届联盟杯的决赛。联盟杯是美国职业足球大联盟（MLS）和墨西哥足球甲级联赛（Liga MX）俱乐部参加的足球赛事。决赛于2024年8月25日在美国俄亥俄州哥伦布市的Lower.com球场举行，由东道主哥伦布机员队对阵洛杉矶足球俱乐部。哥伦布以3比1获胜，库乔·埃尔南德斯攻入两球；现场观众为20,190人。

en.s: The 2024 DFB-supercup, known as Google Pixel Supercup der Frauen for sponsorship reasons, was the seventh iteration and first after restart, of German women's super cup, contested by the winners of the previous season's top league and national cup competition. In 2024, the contestants were Bayern Munich, as the champions of the 2023–24 Bundesliga, and VfL Wolfsburg as the winners of the 2023–24 DFB-Pokal.

zh.s: 2024年德国女子超级杯因赞助商关系也称Google Pixel女子超级杯，是该赛事第七届，也是赛事重启后的首届。比赛由上一赛季顶级联赛冠军和德国杯冠军对阵。2024年的参赛队伍是2023—24赛季德甲冠军拜仁慕尼黑，以及德国杯冠军沃尔夫斯堡。

en.s: The Chapter 183: Hundred Volts was a professional wrestling event produced by Progress Wrestling. It took place on 25 August 2025 in London, England, at the Electric Ballroom. Eight matches were contested at the event. The main event saw Man Like DeReiss defeat Luke Jacobs in a Tables, Ladders, and Chairs match to win the PROGRESS World Championship.

zh.s: 2025年8月25日，Progress Wrestling在英格兰伦敦的Electric Ballroom举办职业摔角赛事“第183期：百伏特”。赛事共进行了8场比赛。主赛中，Man Like DeReiss在桌梯椅赛中击败Luke Jacobs，赢得PROGRESS世界冠军。
